t.en: One-dimensional Interpolation
t.zh: 一维插值

t.en: Octave supports several methods for one-dimensional interpolation, most of which are described in this section. Polynomial Interpolation and Interpolation on Scattered Data describe additional methods.
t.zh: Octave 支持多种一维插值方法，大部分在本节中介绍。“多项式插值”和“散乱数据插值”两节介绍了另外一些方法。

t.en: One-dimensional interpolation.
t.zh: 一维插值。

t.en: Interpolate input data to determine the value of *yi* at the points *xi*. If not specified, *x* is taken to be the indices of *y* (`1:length (y)`). If *y* is a matrix or an N-dimensional array, the interpolation is performed on each column of *y*.
t.zh: 对输入数据做插值，求出函数在点*xi*处的值*yi*。若未指定，*x*取为*y*的下标（`1:length (y)`）。若*y*是矩阵或 N 维数组，则对*y*的每一列分别做插值。

t.en: The interpolation *method* is one of:
t.zh: 插值方法*method*可以是下列之一：

t.en: Return the nearest neighbor.
t.zh: 返回最近邻点的值。

t.en: Return the previous neighbor.
t.zh: 返回前一个邻点的值。

t.en: Return the next neighbor.
t.zh: 返回后一个邻点的值。

t.en: Linear interpolation from nearest neighbors.
t.zh: 由最近的邻点做线性插值。

t.en: Piecewise cubic Hermite interpolating polynomial—shape-preserving interpolation with smooth first derivative.
t.zh: 分段三次 Hermite 插值多项式——保持形状的插值，一阶导数光滑。

t.en: Cubic interpolation (same as `"pchip"`).
t.zh: 三次插值（与 `"pchip"` 相同）。

t.en: Cubic spline interpolation—smooth first and second derivatives throughout the curve.
t.zh: 三次样条插值——整条曲线的一阶、二阶导数都光滑。

t.en: Adding '*' to the start of any method above forces `interp1` to assume that *x* is uniformly spaced, and only `x(1)` and `x(2)` are referenced. This is usually faster, and is never slower. The default method is `"linear"`.
t.zh: 在上述任一方法名的开头加上 '*'，会强制 `interp1` 假定*x*是等间距的，只引用 `x(1)` 和 `x(2)`。这通常更快，而且绝不会更慢。默认方法是 `"linear"`。

t.en: If *extrap* is the string `"extrap"`, then extrapolate values beyond the endpoints using the current *method*. If *extrap* is a number, then replace values beyond the endpoints with that number. When unspecified, *extrap* defaults to `NA`.
t.zh: 若*extrap*是字符串 `"extrap"`，则用当前的*method*对端点之外的值做外推。若*extrap*是一个数，则把端点之外的值替换为该数。未指定时，*extrap*默认为 `NA`。

t.en: If the string argument `"pp"` is specified, then *xi* should not be supplied and `interp1` returns a piecewise polynomial object. This object can later be used with `ppval` to evaluate the interpolation. There is an equivalence, such that `ppval (interp1 (x, y, method, "pp"), xi) == interp1 (x, y, xi, method, "extrap")`.
t.zh: 若指定字符串参数 `"pp"`，则不应提供*xi*，此时 `interp1` 返回一个分段多项式对象。这个对象以后可以配合 `ppval` 来计算插值。二者存在如下等价关系：`ppval (interp1 (x, y, method, "pp"), xi) == interp1 (x, y, xi, method, "extrap")`。

t.en: Duplicate points in *x* specify a discontinuous interpolant. There may be at most 2 consecutive points with the same value. If *x* is increasing, the default discontinuous interpolant is right-continuous. If *x* is decreasing, the default discontinuous interpolant is left-continuous. The continuity condition of the interpolant may be specified by using the options `"left"` or `"right"` to select a left-continuous or right-continuous interpolant, respectively. Discontinuous interpolation is only allowed for `"nearest"` and `"linear"` methods; in all other cases, the *x*-values must be unique.
t.zh: *x*中的重复点表示一个不连续的插值函数。连续相同的点最多只能有 2 个。若*x*递增，则默认的不连续插值函数是右连续的；若*x*递减，则默认的不连续插值函数是左连续的。可以用选项 `"left"` 或 `"right"` 分别选择左连续或右连续的插值函数，以指定插值函数的连续性条件。不连续插值只允许用于 `"nearest"` 和 `"linear"` 方法；在其他所有情形下，*x*的值必须互不相同。

t.en: See also: `pchip`, `spline`, `interpft`, `interp2`, `interp3`, `interpn`.
t.zh: 另见：`pchip`、`spline`、`interpft`、`interp2`、`interp3`、`interpn`。

t.en: There are some important differences between the various interpolation methods. The `"spline"` method enforces that both the first and second derivatives of the interpolated values have a continuous derivative, whereas the other methods do not. This means that the results of the `"spline"` method are generally smoother. If the function to be interpolated is in fact smooth, then `"spline"` will give excellent results. However, if the function to be evaluated is in some manner discontinuous, then `"pchip"` interpolation might give better results.
t.zh: 各种插值方法之间有一些重要的差别。`"spline"` 方法强制要求插值结果的一阶导数和二阶导数都具有连续的导数，而其他方法没有这个要求。这意味着 `"spline"` 方法的结果通常更光滑。如果待插值的函数本身是光滑的，那么 `"spline"` 会给出极好的结果。但是，如果待求值的函数在某种程度上是不连续的，那么 `"pchip"` 插值可能给出更好的结果。

t.en: Fourier interpolation, is a resampling technique where a signal is converted to the frequency domain, padded with zeros and then reconverted to the time domain.
t.zh: 傅里叶插值是一种重采样技术：先把信号转换到频域，补零，再转换回时域。

t.en: There are two significant limitations on Fourier interpolation. First, the function signal is assumed to be periodic, and so non-periodic signals will be poorly represented at the edges. Second, both the signal and its interpolation are required to be sampled at equispaced points. An example of the use of `interpft` is

t.en: In addition, the support functions `spline` and `lookup` that underlie the `interp1` function can be called directly.
t.zh: 此外，作为 `interp1` 函数底层支撑的 `spline` 和 `lookup` 函数，也可以直接调用。

t.en: Return the cubic spline interpolant of points *x* and *y*.
t.zh: 返回点*x*和*y*的三次样条插值函数。

t.en: When called with two arguments, return the piecewise polynomial *pp* that may be used with `ppval` to evaluate the polynomial at specific points.
t.zh: 带两个参数调用时，返回分段多项式*pp*，它可以配合 `ppval` 在指定点上计算多项式的值。

t.en: When called with a third input argument, `spline` evaluates the spline at the points *xi*. The third calling form `spline (x, y, xi)` is equivalent to `ppval (spline (x, y), xi)`.
t.zh: 带第三个输入参数调用时，`spline` 在点*xi*处计算样条的值。第三种调用形式 `spline (x, y, xi)` 等价于 `ppval (spline (x, y), xi)`。

t.en: The variable *x* must be a vector of length *n*.
t.zh: 变量*x*必须是长度为*n*的向量。

t.en: *y* can be either a vector or array. If *y* is a vector it must have a length of either *n* or `n + 2`. If the length of *y* is *n*, then the `"not-a-knot"` end condition is used. If the length of *y* is `n + 2`, then the first and last values of the vector *y* are the values of the first derivative of the cubic spline at the endpoints.
t.zh: *y*可以是向量或数组。若*y*是向量，其长度必须是*n*或 `n + 2`。若*y*的长度为*n*，则使用 `"not-a-knot"` 端点条件。若*y*的长度为 `n + 2`，则向量*y*的第一个和最后一个值，是三次样条在两个端点处的一阶导数值。

t.en: Multi-dimensional Interpolation
t.zh: 多维插值

t.en: There are three multi-dimensional interpolation functions in Octave, with similar capabilities. Methods using Delaunay tessellation are described in Interpolation on Scattered Data.
t.zh: Octave 中有三个多维插值函数，功能相近。使用 Delaunay 剖分的方法在“散乱数据插值”一节中介绍。

blocks.name: interp2
sigs: zi = interp2 (x, y, z, xi, yi)

t.en: Two-dimensional interpolation.
t.zh: 二维插值。

t.en: Interpolate reference data *x*, *y*, *z* to determine *zi* at the coordinates *xi*, *yi*. The reference data *x*, *y* can be matrices, as returned by `meshgrid`, in which case the sizes of *x*, *y*, and *z* must be equal. If *x*, *y* are vectors describing a grid then `length (x) == columns (z)` and `length (y) == rows (z)`. In either case the input data must be strictly monotonic.
t.zh: 对参考数据*x*、*y*、*z*做插值，求出坐标（*xi*，*yi*）处的*zi*。参考数据*x*、*y*可以是 `meshgrid` 返回的那种矩阵，此时*x*、*y*、*z*的大小必须相等。若*x*、*y*是描述网格的向量，则 `length (x) == columns (z)` 且 `length (y) == rows (z)`。无论哪种情形，输入数据都必须严格单调。

t.en: If called without *x*, *y*, and just a single reference data matrix *z*, the 2-D region `x = 1:columns (z), y = 1:rows (z)` is assumed. This saves memory if the grid is regular and the distance between points is not important.
t.zh: 若调用时没有*x*、*y*，只有一个参考数据矩阵*z*，则假定二维区域为 `x = 1:columns (z), y = 1:rows (z)`。当网格是规则的、而点与点之间的距离并不重要时，这样做可以节省内存。

t.en: If called with a single reference data matrix *z* and a refinement value *n*, then perform interpolation over a grid where each original interval has been recursively subdivided *n* times. This results in `2^n-1` additional points for every interval in the original grid. If *n* is omitted a value of 1 is used. As an example, the interval [0,1] with `n==2` results in a refined interval with points at [0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1].
t.zh: 若调用时只有一个参考数据矩阵*z*和一个加密值*n*，则在这样的网格上做插值：原网格的每个区间被递归地细分*n*次。这样，原网格的每个区间会多出 `2^n-1` 个点。若省略*n*，则取值 1。例如，区间 [0,1] 在 `n==2` 时，得到的加密区间的点为 [0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1]。

t.en: The interpolation *method* is one of:
t.zh: 插值方法*method*可以是下列之一：

t.en: Return the nearest neighbor.
t.zh: 返回最近邻点的值。

t.en: Linear interpolation from nearest neighbors.
t.zh: 由最近的邻点做线性插值。

t.en: Piecewise cubic Hermite interpolating polynomial—shape-preserving interpolation with smooth first derivative.
t.zh: 分段三次 Hermite 插值多项式——保持形状的插值，一阶导数光滑。

t.en: Cubic interpolation using a convolution kernel function—third order method with smooth first derivative.
t.zh: 使用卷积核函数的三次插值——三阶方法，一阶导数光滑。

t.en: Cubic spline interpolation—smooth first and second derivatives throughout the curve.
t.zh: 三次样条插值——整条曲线的一阶、二阶导数都光滑。

t.en: *extrap* is a scalar number. It replaces values beyond the endpoints with *extrap*. Note that if *extrap* is used, *method* must be specified as well. If *extrap* is omitted and the *method* is `"spline"`, then the extrapolated values of the `"spline"` are used. Otherwise the default *extrap* value for any other *method* is `"NA"`. See also: `interp1`, `interp3`, `interpn`, `meshgrid`.
t.zh: *extrap*是一个标量。它把端点之外的值替换为*extrap*。注意，若使用了*extrap*，则也必须指定*method*。若省略*extrap*且*method*为 `"spline"`，则使用 `"spline"` 的外推值。否则，对其他任何*method*，*extrap*的默认值为 `"NA"`。另见：`interp1`、`interp3`、`interpn`、`meshgrid`。

t.en: A significant difference between `interpn` and the other two multi-dimensional interpolation functions is the fashion in which the dimensions are treated. For `interp2` and `interp3`, the y-axis is considered to be the columns of the matrix, whereas the x-axis corresponds to the rows of the array. As Octave indexes arrays in column major order, the first dimension of any array is the columns, and so `interpn` effectively reverses the 'x' and 'y' dimensions. Consider the example,
t.zh: `interpn` 与另外两个多维插值函数的一个重要区别，在于处理各维度的方式。对 `interp2` 和 `interp3` 来说，y 轴对应矩阵的列，而 x 轴对应数组的行。由于 Octave 按列优先的顺序对数组做索引，任何数组的第一个维度都是列，所以 `interpn` 实际上把 'x' 和 'y' 两个维度颠倒了。看下面的例子，

t.zh: 其中 `vi` 和 `vi2` 是相同的。维度的颠倒分别由 `meshgrid` 和 `ndgrid` 函数处理。这段代码的结果见 fig:interpn。
